svg.title: bandproduct92 — one source gate c ^= a | !b through the product-share Gray fold
svg.desc: The replicated per-gate body only: Gray fold V = C ⊕ M(B) ⊕ κ, 2 value relocations (rg_freq), mask re-source, band roll. Cost is a seeded draw ≈ 92 on average — the '92' in the name; seed 10 was chosen so this instance draws the average (92 at n=8). The one-time mask injection (cleartext→encoded input) and the final strip/route-home (decoding) are fixed infrastructure and are NOT shown — injection is still run so the fold draws against a stocked ledger.
